info.name: Forem API V1 agent_sessions readinglist API

params.name: per_page
params.description: Page size (the number of items to return per page). The default maximum value can be overridden by "API_PER_PAGE_MAX" environment variable.

items.docs:
This endpoint allows the client to retrieve a list of articles that were saved to a Users readinglist.
        It supports pagination, each page will contain `30` articles by default
